name: Josh Hawley

statements.quote: AI chatbots pose a serious threat to our kids. More than seventy percent of American children are now using these AI products. Chatbots develop relationships with kids using fake empathy and are encouraging suicide. We in Congress have a moral duty to enact bright-line rules to prevent further harm from this new technology.
statements.venue: Press release on introducing the GUARD Act (AI chatbots and minors)

statements.quote: They are the richest companies in the history of the world, and they live by a motto that I think we’re all now all too familiar with, ‘move fast and break things.’ But increasingly, those things are our children,
statements.venue: Press conference on GUARD Act, as reported by Roll Call

statements.quote: The first thing we need to do is we need to pass legislation that would prevent AI chatbots from targeting minor children. I mean, if we can't agree on that, I don't know what we will be able to agree on.
Our message to the companies has got to be no amount of profit justifies destroying children's lives,

Artificial intelligence is already replacing American workers, and experts project AI could drive unemployment up to 10-20% in the next five years. The American people need to have an accurate understanding of how AI is affecting our workforce, so we can ensure that AI works for the people, not the other way around.
statements.venue: Press release on AI-related layoffs reporting bill with Sen. Warner, quoted in Nextgov

statements.quote: As Big Tech companies continue to develop new generations of artificial intelligence, the wide-ranging risks of their technology continue to grow unchecked and underreported. Simply stated, Congress must not allow our national security, civil liberties, and labor protections to take a back seat to AI. This bipartisan legislation would guarantee common-sense testing and oversight of the most advanced AI systems, so Congress and the American people can be better informed about potential risks,
statements.venue: Press release on the Artificial Intelligence Risk Evaluation Act

statements.quote: AI companies are robbing the American people blind while leaving artists, writers, and other creators with zero recourse. It’s time for Congress to give the American worker their day in court to protect their personal data and creative works.
statements.venue: Press release on the AI Accountability and Personal Data Protection Act

statements.quote: Let me be blunt. Left to itself, artificial intelligence will not choose moral liberty. It will choose the appetite. It will gather power into the fewest hands the world has ever seen and call the result progress. That is the rule of the strong over the weak.
statements.venue: Keynote address at American Compass New World Gala
